legacyKeyRules.rules: Index counts every entry before enabled/if filtering; disabled entries retain slots. Used directly for chest and unique pickup flags, and passed as key to extension entities. Preserve type/map/index separately plus exact legacy key. Never renumber after filtering, sorting or scene import.

legacyKeyRules.format: base DATA.objects -> ordered registry enrich hooks -> first_route/access_points preparation -> append Beroepen.resource_objects
legacyKeyRules.rules: Final authored order, including disabled slots and appended content, is identity-sensitive. Map registry has 19 enrich calls plus conditional swamp preparation and inn memory-book append; preserve exact executable order, not alphabetic file order. Runtime-only living scenery objects may use explicit IDs instead of array slots.

Tile coordinate inferred from altar position divided by32. Discovery proves actual use, not merely visiting map. Preserve spawn target, safe arrival, discovery flag and label; relocating altar needs an explicit identity alias.
Explicit obj.id indexes professions.cooldowns; distinct from its generic object key.
Coordinates are identity-sensitive; exact enriched-map membership checked when loading cooldowns.
Species/planned ID rather than resulting position indexes cooldown; exact enriched object membership required.
Preserve species identity and resource kind; decorating/repositioning must not create another logical resource.
Not generic map-array keys. Current profession normalizer does not enumerate this dynamic-ID family; preserve raw data and document this asymmetry rather than silently changing it.

legacyKeyRules.format: animal identity=<map_id>:<animal_kind>:<home_tile_x>,<home_tile_y>; drop identity=<animal identity>:<int(play_time*1000)>; collected flag=hs_drop:<drop identity>
legacyKeyRules.rules: Saved animal_due and drop records prevent duplicate manure; retain home-position identity even if current roaming position differs. Drop position is world pixels, home key uses tile coordinates.
Farm parser allows int conversion; yard requires canonical valid integers and exact round-trip key. These are local village tile coordinates, not world pixels.

legacyKeyRules.format: base kind IDs bed/table/shelf; optional kind:<positive_instance_number>
legacyKeyRules.rules: Keep ID, kind, cell, tint and ownership separately. IDs cannot be recreated arbitrarily from scene instance IDs or list order.
Stored in flags, not another save field; focus valid only for currently active quest. Explicit current recipe goal is professions.goal, separate from this quest focus.

legacyKeyRules.format: stable string IDs and ordered condition/action arrays
legacyKeyRules.rules: Quest/NPC/dialogue/item/recipe/enemy/gate/trigger-once IDs and arbitrary custom flag namespaces must stay byte-identical or have explicit lossless alias mappings; translated display names are never identities.

limitations: Registry slots retain their exact source indices but are not certified final world.load_map indices.
Post-registry resource append order is preserved; no final runtime index is invented.
Runtime-only living scenery resources, spawned actors and state-dependent membership need phase5 export.
Generic type:map:index strings are candidate object keys; individual handlers decide actual persistence.
Altar arrival safety, runtime transforms, conditional spawn state and coordinates need phase5 validation.
Unknown save keys and original ConfigFile/InputEvent bytes remain raw; no save import is implemented.

namespaceRules.encoding: Separate namespace array and exact typed id; never delimiter concatenation
namespaceRules.professionCooldownIds: globally unique exact strings, including map/prefix characters
namespaceRules.unknownSaveData: Preserve original bytes and unknown fields; no converter in phase4

appearance.rule: Defaults gender m/hair m_kort/hair_color 2/eyes rond/eye_color 0. Gender v only on exact v, otherwise m. Hair must belong to gender's catalog, else third style by catalog order; eyes must be known, else rond. Color indexes int-cast and clamped to catalog bounds. Catalog order is part of index semantics.

clothing.rule: Known slot, Dictionary entry, correct known item for slot and finite numeric owned quantity>=1. Keep {item,dye}; dye int-cast and clamped to palette bounds. Cosmetic clothing remains distinct from equipment/bonuses.

coastal_storage.rule: Dictionary with known material-type items only; max 12 distinct slots in source iteration order; each finite numeric count>=1 truncates/clamps to 1..99.

equipment.rule: Known slot, string item belonging to exactly that slot, finite numeric owned count>=1. Otherwise omit entry. normalize_owned retains only registered gear IDs at quantity 1. Empty selection is intentional and must remain empty; ownership alone provides no gear bonus.

hero_xp.rule: Only finite int/float, truncate after clamp 0..2250; other values ->0. Levels derive from 25*(level-1)*level, maximum level 10; levels are not saved separately.

fields.wild_due: absolute active play_time deadline for wild grapes

rules: Valid farm cells are Rect2i(4,29,31,12), excluding columns 20 and 21; only soil/channel entries remain.
Known soil crops retain growth 0..duration and exact-true fertilized. established exact true is retained only if that crop has a regrow duration.
Registered crop IDs: grape,flower,carrot,pumpkin,mint,rosemary,apple,berry; crop duration/yield are defined by orchard_catalog.gd.
Jobs: compost cost 2 manure, yield 3 fertilizer, 30s; wine_a and wine_b cost 3 grapes, yield 1 wine, 90s. Each job batches finite numeric clamp/truncate 1..20 and elapsed time 0..job duration.
animal_due and drops: at most 128 entries each; IDs must be strings <=140 characters. animal_due clamp 0..loaded play_time+90. Runtime creates at most 64 drops.
Drop map must be string and pos a two-number array; coordinates finite-normalized to 0..10000. Normalizer does not whitelist the map string.
wild_due clamp 0..loaded play_time+120; honey integer 0..8; honey_time 0..120. Invalid/nonfinite numeric input falls to the lower bound.

personal_home.rule: Defaults also contain zero-owned entries for all other catalog kinds. Known owned counts cannot fall below starter ownership and clamp at kind cap. Accept layout only if whole layout_reason succeeds; otherwise retain default layout while preserving normalized ownership/style. Max12 pieces, max26 solid cells; bed/table/shelf mandatory; grid room [2,12)x[2,12), fixed fixtures/reserved paths/no overlaps and full connected walkable floor. Non-base furniture ID kind:1..cap; base ID exactly kind. Integer tint 0..2.

fields.cooldowns: exact resource_id -> absolute active play_time deadline
fields.goal: optional nonempty registered recipe_id string; invalid or empty values omitted by normalization
fields.xp: skill -> finite numeric integer 0..1350 for registered skills

professions.rule: Discard expired deadlines <= loaded play_time; clamp each valid deadline to play_time+that resource's own cooldown. Legacy placements use exact map:resource IDs. trail:/winter:/forestfood: IDs are checked against actual enriched map objects, not merely accepted by prefix. Preserve raw data that normalization drops.

stockroom.rule: home accepts known material/use/ammo items, max 144 distinct slots in source iteration order, finite numeric count>=1 clamps/truncates to 1..999. No equipment is stored here. favorites retains known IDs with value==true. sort finite numeric truncates/clamps 0..3; else 0.

rules: Retain valid registered map IDs with raw value of type bool and value true; numeric 1 is not accepted.
Always add a valid raw saved current map. If visited_maps key exists at all, stop evidence inference, even for empty or malformed field.
Only when field is absent: exact positive raw chest/pickup/savepoint proof keys from actual enriched map inventory prove that exact map.
Raw talked IDs prove a map only when their static NPC ID occurs in exactly one map; exclude meer_joris because he also appears dynamically at the inn.
Explicit positive raw wm_met_<role> proves world_memory.PLACES[role].map. Explicit boss/location flags use the fixed legacy map below.
No gear, quests, achievement metadata, route unlock or inferred intermediate/parent location grants visitation.
Actual completed world map loads call record_map_visit; inspecting atlas/routes never does. New game and NG+ reset adventure visit history.

fields.extensions: array of unique known extension IDs

yard.rule: Known extensions west/east; known supply counts finite, clamped by per-group cap and starter minimum. Stations [] preserved; two finite coordinates in [0,40)x[0,44) truncate to integers. If initial station layout invalid, changed stations are stored rather than destroying crops/jobs. Add optional pieces individually with exact canonical cell keys and correct path/fence kind; max80 paths/max40 fences. Validate land ownership, terrain, reserved/fixed cells, existing farm/tree cover, station spacing, material ownership and connectivity. If final whole layout invalid, clear paths/fences only. Farm is normalized first and is not overwritten.
